description: Figure 1 is a bar chart titled "Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob," which compares the performance of three text analysis algorithms. The horizontal axis lists the three algorithms: VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT. The vertical axis represents accuracy, with a scale from 0.4 to 1.0. The chart displays three bars, each corresponding to one algorithm. The bar for VADER is white and has a value of approximately 0.7. The bar for TextBlob is patterned with diagonal lines and has a value of approximately 0.68. The bar for ChatGPT is solid green and is the tallest, with a value of approximately 0.95. A legend in the lower right corner identifies the white bar as VADER, the patterned bar as TextBlob, and the green bar as ChatGPT.
